Senior Backend Engineer
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own APIs and platform reliability for our career-automation product.

Responsibilities
- Design and ship production Node.js and TypeScript services
- Operate Docker and Kubernetes workloads on AWS
- Improve PostgreSQL and Redis performance
- Partner with frontend engineers on React integrations

Requirements / Must have
- 5+ years of experience
- JavaScript and TypeScript
- Node.js, REST APIs
- Docker and Kubernetes (k8s)
- PostgreSQL or Redis
- System Design and microservices
- Git and CI/CD

Nice to have / Preferred
- Python and FastAPI
- GraphQL
- Terraform
- Leadership and mentoring
